title: Michael wonders who built the pyramids and the English standing stones

tellings.quote: How this stone got here in England? Them them them stones. Who who did this?

plain: Michael, a man who says he was abducted by aliens, speaks on a podcast about ancient monuments. He wonders aloud who built the pyramids of Egypt and how the great standing stones of England got where they are. He asks it as a hint that someone other than ordinary people of the time may have been involved.
